decisions.evidence: r26 maker offers 'which interaction feels clearer: the visible Edit bookmark button... or clicking the whole card?'; r26 client 'The visible Edit bookmark button feels clearer... when I click a saved bookmark I actually want it to take me to the original page... let clicking the bookmark itself open the link.'

Client explicitly selected the reference-conforming alternative, reserving card-click for opening the original.
